title: Externals ready for me
quote: When I'm about to eat a big hit I need to see at a glance which external can reach me and who owns it, without scanning the whole panel.
what: A small strip that lists only the externals that can target the tank (Guardian Spirit, Pain Suppression, Blessing of Sacrifice, Life Cocoon, Ironbark, Hand of Sacrifice, Blessing of Protection) with the owner's name and ready or time left. Ready ones sort first.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (only players running the addon show); Possible on Era, TBC and MoP (combat log)
today: Today: one flat list of all tracked spells, no tank-focused view; Blessing of Sacrifice is not on the Retail list

title: Externals landed on me
quote: I want to know which external is already running on me and when it ends, so I don't ask for a second one on top.
what: Show a marker on the owner's icon when their external is active on the tank and how long the buff lasts, then switch to the cooldown timer after it ends.
possible: Partly on Retail and Forever (tank's own buffs are secret in combat, so only a shown widget, no logic); Possible on Era, TBC, MoP
today: Today: cooldown timers only, no buff-on-target tracking

title: Sound and screen alert when a key cooldown is back
quote: I'm watching boss mechanics, I won't look at a panel, but I will hear a ping when the healer's Pain Suppression is back.
what: Optional sound or flash when a chosen spell goes ready, or when the battle rez gets a charge. Picked per spell in Settings, with an off switch.
today: Today: ready-now messages go to other clients, no sound or flash on the receiving end

title: Call for an external from the panel
quote: I shouldn't have to type who has what; one click should ask the right healer for the right button.
what: Click a ready external on the panel to send a short chat or whisper line like 'Pain Suppression on me at 3 stacks, please' to its owner. Shift-click announces the next ready external to the group.
possible: Possible on every client (sending your own chat is allowed, reading other casts is not needed)
today: Today: only Request Rez announces to chat; the rest of the panel is read-only

title: Rez request for a hotkey and macro
quote: In a wipe I need a battle rez called in one keypress, not typing a slash command while the boss resets.
what: A secure button and a documented macro line that calls the rez on the target, and a 'who is next in rez order' pick when several are ready. Also lets the tank, not just leaders, ask when allowed.
possible: Partly on Retail and Forever (macro button fine, rez ready info only for addon users)
today: Today: /cdc rez, leader or assist only, announces the ready rez by name

title: Tank cooldowns on Retail and MoP
quote: I run Retail keys and my co-tank's Shield Wall, Last Stand and taunts matter just as much as the healer's cooldowns.
what: Add tank personals and swap tools to the spell lists: Shield Wall, Last Stand, Guardian Spirit style defensives, Challenging Shout, Rallying Cry already, and taunts like Provoke, Dark Command, Taunt. Co-tanks see each other's state.
possible: Partly on Retail and Forever (needs addon on the co-tank); Possible on MoP, TBC, Era
today: Today: Shield Wall and Challenging Shout only on TBC, Era, Forever; Retail and MoP lists have no tank personals or taunts

title: Group role filters and presets
quote: In a 25-man raid the panel is a wall of icons; I want only what I act on, set once per boss.
what: Filter the panel by role or by purpose (externals, raid cooldowns, rez, lust) with saved presets, plus a compact 'tank mode' that hides spells I never call for.
today: Today: per-spell tick boxes in Settings, no presets or role filters

title: Dead or out-of-range owner warning
quote: A cooldown that's ready but its owner is dead or across the room is not an option, and I'd like the panel to say so.
what: Grey out or mark icons whose owner is dead, offline or out of range, and drop them out of the ready count in the Essentials bar.
possible: Partly on Retail and Forever (dead and offline are readable; range to others may be limited in combat)
today: Today: roster scan shows who can provide, no alive, online or range state on icons

title: Pull-time cooldown check
quote: Before a pull I want one line: lust ready, rez charges, which externals are up, so I can say 'go' with confidence.
what: On ready check or a pull timer, print or show a short summary of the group's lust, battle rez charges and key externals, with names of anyone whose cooldown is still running.
possible: Partly on Retail and Forever (only addon users counted); Possible on Era, TBC, MoP
today: Today: /cdc roster lists providers, nothing ties to ready check or pull

title: Cooldown recap after a wipe or kill
quote: After a wipe I want to see who burned what and when, so I can fix the plan next pull.
what: A short log of tracked cooldowns used during the last pull with time into the fight and who cast them, shown in a small window or a chat summary.
possible: Partly on Retail and Forever (only addon users' casts are known); Possible on Era, TBC, MoP
today: Today: no history, only current timers
